    44	@asynccontextmanager
    45	async def lifespan(app: FastAPI) -> AsyncGenerator[None, None]:
    46	    """Application lifespan — startup and shutdown hooks.
    47	
    48	    Startup: log ready.
    49	    Shutdown: dispose database engine so connections are returned to the pool.
    50	    Docker/uvicorn handle SIGTERM natively; no custom signal handlers needed.
    51	    """
    52	    from webapp.dependencies import _session_factory
    53	
    54	    logger.info("FastAPI startup complete")
    55	    yield
    56	    # Shutdown: dispose DB engine if one was initialised
    57	    if _session_factory is not None:
    58	        engine = _session_factory.kw.get("bind")
    59	        if engine is not None:
    60	            logger.info("Closing database connection pool")
    61	            await engine.dispose()
    62	            logger.info("Database connections closed")

    65	def create_app() -> FastAPI:
    66	    """Create and configure the FastAPI application."""
    67	    app = FastAPI(
    68	        title="Guitar Tone Shootout",
    69	        description="Compare guitar tones with scientific precision",
    70	        version="0.1.0",
    71	        lifespan=lifespan,
    72	    )
    73	
    74	    # Initialize database (for tests, DATABASE_URL can be set externally)
    75	    database_url = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL")
    76	    if database_url:
    77	        init_db(database_url)
    78	
    79	    # Middleware order: outermost first (RequestID -> Timing -> CORS)
    80	    # CORS must be added last so it's innermost (FastAPI reverses order)
    81	    cors_origins_env = os.getenv("CORS_ORIGINS", "http://localhost:9000")
    82	    cors_origins = [o.strip() for o in cors_origins_env.split(",")]
    83	    # Always allow local development origins
    84	    for dev_origin in ["http://localhost:3000", "http://localhost:9000"]:
    85	        if dev_origin not in cors_origins:
    86	            cors_origins.append(dev_origin)
    87	    app.add_middleware(
    88	        CORSMiddleware,
    89	        allow_origins=cors_origins,
    90	        allow_credentials=True,
    91	        allow_methods=["*"],
    92	        allow_headers=["*"],
    93	    )
    94	    app.add_middleware(TimingMiddleware)
    95	    app.add_middleware(RequestIDMiddleware)
    96	
    97	    # Mount exception handlers
    98	    app.add_exception_handler(AppException, app_exception_handler)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    99	    app.add_exception_handler(StarletteHTTPException, http_exception_handler)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
   100	    app.add_exception_handler(RequestValidationError, request_validation_error_handler)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
   101	    app.add_exception_handler(SQLAlchemyError, sqlalchemy_error_handler)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
   102	    # Register RuntimeError explicitly so it's handled by ExceptionMiddleware
   103	    # (which does NOT re-raise). FastAPI routes the generic Exception handler to
   104	    # ServerErrorMiddleware, which always re-raises after responding — this
   105	    # breaks ASGITransport tests and wraps in ExceptionGroup with BaseHTTPMiddleware.
   106	    app.add_exception_handler(RuntimeError, unhandled_exception_handler)
   107	    app.add_exception_handler(Exception, unhandled_exception_handler)
   108	
   109	    # Include API routers

   123	    app.include_router(pages.router)
   124

   126	    env = os.getenv("ENV", "production")
   127	    if env == "development":
   128	        app.include_router(test.router, tags=["test"])
   129	
   130	    # Override database dependencies with our initialized one.
   131	    # Only override modules that raise NotImplementedError (no fallback).
   132	    # Pages use webapp.auth.dependencies.get_db_session (centralised)
   133	    # which already falls back to get_db and supports test overrides.
   134	    if database_url:

   142	        return RedirectResponse(url="/login", status_code=302)
   143

   112	    async def generate_permutations(self, group_id: UUID) -> list[str]:
   113	        """Generate signal chain permutations from a group's gear options.
   114	
   115	        Computes the cartesian product of gear options across slots, then
   116	        creates a SignalChain for each permutation.
   117	
   118	        Args:
   119	            group_id: ID of the group to generate permutations for
   120	
   121	        Returns:
   122	            List of created chain IDs as strings
   123	
   124	        Raises:
   125	            ValueError: If group not found or exceeds max_permutations
   126	        """
   127	        group = await self.repository.get_by_id(group_id)
   128	        if group is None:
   129	            raise ValueError(f"Group not found: {group_id}")
   130	
   131	        # Validate permutation count
   132	        if group.exceeds_max_permutations():
   133	            raise ValueError(
   134	                f"Too many permutations ({group.estimated_permutation_count()}). "
   135	                f"Maximum is {group.max_permutations}."
   136	            )
   137	
   138	        # Build option lists for each slot position
   139	        # include_null adds a None option only to slots that have no gear options
   140	        slot_options: list[list[UUID | None]] = []
   141	        for pos in group.slot_positions:
   142	            options: list[UUID | None] = list(group.gear_options.get(pos, []))
   143	            if group.include_null and len(options) == 0:
   144	                options.append(None)
   145	            slot_options.append(options)
   146	
   147	        # Compute cartesian product
   148	        permutations = list(itertools.product(*slot_options))
   149	
   150	        # Look up base chain platform (default to NAM)
   151	        platform_value = Platform.NAM.value
   152	        if group.base_chain_id:
   153	            stmt = select(SignalChainModel).where(SignalChainModel.id == group.base_chain_id)

   155	            base_chain = result.scalar_one_or_none()

   157	                platform_value = (
   158	                    base_chain.platform.value
   159	                    if hasattr(base_chain.platform, "value")
   160	                    else str(base_chain.platform)
   161	                )
   162	
   163	        # Create a SignalChain for each permutation
   164	        chain_ids: list[str] = []
   165	        for i, perm in enumerate(permutations):
   166	            chain_id = uuid4()
   167	
   168	            # Build descriptive name
   169	            parts = []
   170	            for slot_idx, gear_id in enumerate(perm):
   171	                if gear_id is None:
   172	                    parts.append("none")
   173	                else:
   174	                    parts.append(f"slot{group.slot_positions[slot_idx]}")
   175	            perm_label = " / ".join(parts)
   176	            chain_name = f"{group.name} — #{i + 1} ({perm_label})"
   177	
   178	            chain = SignalChainModel(
   179	                id=chain_id,
   180	                user_id=group.user_id,
   181	                name=chain_name,
   182	                platform=platform_value,
   183	                group_id=group.id,
   184	                blocks=[],
   185	            )
   186	            self.session.add(chain)
   187	            chain_ids.append(str(chain_id))
   188	
   189	        await self.session.flush()
   190	        return chain_ids

1	"""SignalChainGroup entity for domain layer.
     2	
     3	Groups of signal chains for permutation-based comparisons.
     4	"""
     5	
     6	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
     7	from datetime import datetime
     8	from uuid import UUID
     9	
    10	from gts.domain.entities.base import Entity, new_id, utcnow
    11	
    12	
    13	@dataclass(eq=False, slots=True)
    14	class SignalChainGroup(Entity):
    15	    """Entity representing a group of signal chains for comparison.
    16	
    17	    Groups allow users to compare multiple gear options at specific
    18	    positions in a chain. The system generates permutations to test
    19	    all combinations.
    20	
    21	    Example: Compare 3 amps with 2 cabs = 6 permutations
    22	
    23	    Attributes:
    24	        id: Unique identifier
    25	        user_id: Owner's user ID
    26	        name: Display name for the group
    27	        description: Optional description
    28	        base_chain_id: The base signal chain to vary
    29	        slot_positions: Positions in the chain that can vary
    30	        gear_options: Gear options per slot (slot_index -> gear_ids)
    31	        include_null: Whether to include "no gear" as an option
    32	        max_permutations: Maximum permutations to generate
    33	        created_at: When created
    34	        updated_at: When last updated
    35	    """
    36	
    37	    MAX_PERMUTATIONS = 27  # 3^3 - sensible limit
    38	
    39	    user_id: UUID = field(default_factory=new_id)
    40	    name: str = ""
    41	    description: str | None = None
    42	    base_chain_id: UUID | None = None
    43	    slot_positions: list[int] = field(default_factory=list)
    44	    gear_options: dict[int, list[UUID]] = field(default_factory=dict)
    45	    include_null: bool = False
    46	    max_permutations: int = MAX_PERMUTATIONS
    47	    id: UUID = field(default_factory=new_id)
    48	    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=utcnow)
    49	    updated_at: datetime = field(default_factory=utcnow)
    50	
    51	    def add_slot(self, position: int) -> None:
    52	        """Add a variable slot position.
    53	
    54	        Args:
    55	            position: The chain position that can vary
    56	        """
    57	        if position not in self.slot_positions:
    58	            self.slot_positions.append(position)
    59	            self.slot_positions.sort()
    60	            self.gear_options[position] = []
    61	            self.updated_at = utcnow()
    62	
    63	    def remove_slot(self, position: int) -> bool:
    64	        """Remove a variable slot position.
    65	
    66	        Args:
    67	            position: The position to remove
    68	
    69	        Returns:
    70	            True if removed, False if not found
    71	        """
    72	        if position in self.slot_positions:
    73	            self.slot_positions.remove(position)
    74	            self.gear_options.pop(position, None)
    75	            self.updated_at = utcnow()
    76	            return True
    77	        return False
    78	
    79	    def add_gear_option(self, position: int, gear_id: UUID) -> None:
    80	        """Add a gear option for a slot.
    81	
    82	        Args:
    83	            position: The slot position
    84	            gear_id: The gear ID to add as an option
    85	
    86	        Raises:
    87	            ValueError: If position is not a variable slot
    88	        """
    89	        if position not in self.slot_positions:
    90	            raise ValueError(f"Position {position} is not a variable slot")
    91	
    92	        if gear_id not in self.gear_options[position]:
    93	            self.gear_options[position].append(gear_id)
    94	            self.updated_at = utcnow()
    95	
    96	    def remove_gear_option(self, position: int, gear_id: UUID) -> bool:
    97	        """Remove a gear option from a slot.
    98	
    99	        Args:
   100	            position: The slot position
   101	            gear_id: The gear ID to remove
   102	
   103	        Returns:
   104	            True if removed, False if not found
   105	        """
   106	        if position in self.gear_options:
   107	            options = self.gear_options[position]
   108	            if gear_id in options:
   109	                options.remove(gear_id)
   110	                self.updated_at = utcnow()
   111	                return True
   112	        return False
   113	
   114	    def get_option_counts(self) -> list[int]:
   115	        """Get the number of options per slot.
   116	
   117	        Returns:
   118	            List of option counts, one per slot
   119	        """
   120	        counts = []
   121	        for pos in self.slot_positions:
   122	            count = len(self.gear_options.get(pos, []))
   123	            if self.include_null:
   124	                count += 1  # Add 1 for the "no gear" option
   125	            counts.append(count)
   126	        return counts
   127	
   128	    def estimated_permutation_count(self) -> int:
   129	        """Estimate the number of permutations.
   130	
   131	        Returns:
   132	            Estimated permutation count (product of option counts)
   133	        """
   134	        counts = self.get_option_counts()
   135	        if not counts:
   136	            return 0
   137	
   138	        result = 1
   139	        for count in counts:
   140	            result *= max(count, 1)
   141	        return result
   142	
   143	    def exceeds_max_permutations(self) -> bool:
   144	        """Check if permutations would exceed the limit.
   145	
   146	        Returns:
   147	            True if estimated count exceeds max_permutations
   148	        """
   149	        return self.estimated_permutation_count() > self.max_permutations
   150	
   151	    def validate(self) -> list[str]:
   152	        """Validate the group configuration.
   153	
   154	        Returns:
   155	            List of validation error messages (empty if valid)
   156	        """
   157	        errors: list[str] = []
   158	
   159	        if not self.base_chain_id:
   160	            errors.append("Base chain is required")
   161	
   162	        if not self.slot_positions:
   163	            errors.append("At least one variable slot is required")
   164	
   165	        for pos in self.slot_positions:
   166	            options = self.gear_options.get(pos, [])
   167	            min_options = 0 if self.include_null else 1
   168	            if len(options) < min_options:
   169	                errors.append(f"Slot at position {pos} needs at least {min_options} option(s)")
   170	
   171	        if self.exceeds_max_permutations():
   172	            errors.append(
   173	                f"Too many permutations ({self.estimated_permutation_count()}). "
   174	                f"Maximum is {self.max_permutations}."
   175	            )
   176	
   177	        return errors
   178	
   179	    def is_valid(self) -> bool:
   180	        """Check if the group is valid.
   181	
   182	        Returns:
   183	            True if valid, False otherwise
   184	        """
   185	        return len(self.validate()) == 0
